top_choice_rationale: P001 (Katori, Ye) rewards a distinct, mature and independently reproduced achievement: trapping many neutral atoms at the magic wavelength cancels the light shift while keeping Lamb-Dicke confinement, a different architecture from the single-ion clocks (2012) and the frequency comb (2005), reaching about 1e-18 fractional uncertainty. Roles are separable (Katori the concept and first Sr clock, Ye the accuracy frontier) and a citation worded around the magic-wavelength lattice avoids overlap with earlier prizes. Reservations (an instrument advance rather than a new phenomenon, contributions of SYRTE, PTB and others left out) do not outweigh it against no award.
